title: Deterministic time is zero-error time
statement: For every time-bound function $T\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, every language decidable by a finite deterministic Turing machine in time at most a constant multiple of $T$ belongs to the class of languages decidable with zero error and the stated expected-time bound at most a constant multiple of $T$.
